lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in multiple vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit, with approximately 5-7 distinct vertical groupings visible in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating an irregular grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is clearly visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high-intensity light on the dorsal edge to a linear shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible presence of several commensal organisms (remoras) located beneath the pectoral fin and along the ventral boundary of the shark.
